reviews.decision: Complete seven-path patch read: adds an exported upstream standalone table demo, static CSS/HTML/TS, dev-app registration and one overview example reference. The two row templates bind the existing multiTemplateDataRows input; no table/CDK implementation, declaration, provider or style changes occur. The legacy table already retains tests for that input, but their execution does not qualify inherited constructor or row-outlet contracts. No upstream demo or overview is in either package closure, so do not transplant the modern MatTableModule example or claim table behavior clearance.

reviews.subject: docs: convert remaining @NgModule provider examples to bootstrapApplication (#32840)
reviews.decision: Complete eight-path patch read: CDK overlay, experimental README, chips, form-field, input, select, stepper and YouTube guides replace NgModule provider snippets with bootstrapApplication/app-config examples. Provider tokens and values in changed snippets remain the same; the experimental checkbox snippet imports the standalone modern component. No executable implementation, provider factory, token identity, schematic or package dependency changes occur. Those upstream guides are not maintained/shipped here. Preserve legacy modules and distinct legacy tokens; do not mechanically copy modern providers or infer that NgModule use has become unsupported. No younger peer API is introduced.

reviews.subject: docs(material/chips): describe how to use chips in forms #22906 (#29405)
reviews.decision: Complete eight-path patch read: adds two upstream chips form demo CSS/HTML/TS sets, their index exports and a chips overview paragraph. Reactive FormControl and template ngModel bind modern mat-chip-grid; add/remove handlers update signals, trim values, clear input and explicitly call LiveAnnouncer. Static removal aria-label strings include concatenation-looking text rather than an Angular binding, so this example is not accessibility qualification. No chip implementation, ControlValueAccessor, declaration or legacy event change occurs. These unshipped demos do not require a modern API mirror; original legacy forms/repeated-event/announcement contracts remain separately subject to A03/A04 review.
